title: MZ Visustella ATB Plugin - How to check if a target is in a casting state?

posts.author: Uzuki
posts.body: Hey yall, just trying to see if there's a way to use a scriptcall in the conditional branch to check if the target of a skill/item is in the Casting stage of their action.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Yeah, they have
battler.isAtbCastingState()
(change the battler reference). Don't know how it's different from checking
battler._tpbState === "casting"

I tried changing to "target.isAtbCastingState()" but that doesn't seem to be recognized.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Where are you using the
notetag
(edit: script)? It would be 'target' inside most VS notetags. If you're using it in a common event, if they're updated already, you can use Last Actor Enemy Id / Last Target Enemy Index. So I think it's like, actors/enemies:
$gameActors.actor($gameTemp.lastActionData(4)).isAtbCastingState()
$gameTroop.members()[$gameTemp.lastActionData(5)-1].isAtbCastingState()
Depending on where used, you can also get the target with
BattleManager._targets[0].isAtbCastingState()
EDIT: fixed wrong syntax with $gameTroop.members()
